title: Enable or disable Cloudron groups for app access
summary: Super-admins can enable or disable Cloudron directory groups for MyAPES Account so only enabled groups grant access through role mappings.
changes: Added an app allowlist on directory groups with Enable and Disable controls in Admin Groups.
Directory role synchronization ignores disabled groups even when they still have role mappings.
Required Cloudron MyAPES groups stay always enabled; newly discovered non-required groups default to disabled until opted in.
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release introducing an app-level Cloudron group allowlist for MyAPES access control.
validation: PHPUnit coverage for directory catalogue sync defaults, role synchronizer gating, group enable/disable mutations, and Admin Groups UI; Aikido scan on key changed files; myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Catalogue sync still lists all Cloudron groups; disable only removes them from MyAPES authorization, not from Cloudron.
Existing mapped non-required groups remain enabled after upgrade so current access paths are preserved.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, the app_enabled migration (after rolling back the schema change), Groups UI and authorization gating changes, and related tests. Re-run authorization metadata synchronization after rollback. No other schema changes are required.
provenance: Defined by the Cloudron directory group app allowlist for MyAPES Account issue #78 and pull request #79.
